bullets.text: A crowd crush occurred in the front standing area at the Thornlea Park festival ground in Verrow on the evening of July 25, 2025.
Eleven people died, nine at the scene and two in hospital, and 54 people were treated in total.
The event was suspended and attendees were evacuated through the north gates; a major incident was declared by police, ambulance and hospital services.
A criminal investigation into crowd management was opened and the venue's large-event licences were suspended pending review.
Attendees at the front of the main stage report being crushed and unable to move during the headline set.
The performance is stopped and people are lifted out over the front barrier.
Eyewitnesses report multiple unconscious casualties and resuscitation attempts on the ground.
The festival announces the event is suspended and directs attendees to leave through the north gates.
The ambulance service responds to a declared major incident with multiple casualties reported.
Police confirm a major incident at the festival ground and the city infirmary declares a major incident.
Eyewitnesses reported multiple unconscious casualties carried from the front standing area.
The festival was suspended and attendees were evacuated through the north gates.
Attendees were directed to leave the festival ground through the north gates after the event was suspended.
Casualties were lifted out over the front barrier by other attendees and stewards.
The ambulance service responded to a declared major incident with multiple units at the venue.
Police declared a major incident at the festival ground and coordinated the scene response.
Two hospitals received casualties, with the city infirmary declaring a major incident.
Attendees publicly urged others near the main stage to move back and stop pushing forward.
The city infirmary asked the public to attend only for emergencies during the major incident.
Police corrected a circulating claim that the stage had collapsed, stating the incident was a crowd crush.
Relatives publicly appealed for information about attendees in the front standing area.
Eyewitness accounts conveyed distress and disbelief at conditions in the front standing area.
Public frustration was directed at circulating rumours about a stage collapse and a weapon.
